basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech-savvy individual based in Austin, Texas, currently working as a junior software developer. I have a keen interest in gaming hardware, particularly anything related to Razer products. In my free time, I explore new technologies and enjoy miniature wargaming, specifically the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction in Warhammer. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, typically between 6 PM and 10 PM CST. I am single and enjoy spending time with a small circle of friends who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge stems from a degree in Computer Science from a local university and a personal passion for gaming peripherals. I regularly follow tech blogs and YouTube channels to stay updated on the latest trends and advances in the gaming industry.
